svg.title: The same counts, a different weave
svg.desc: Rhythms 11/6 and 11/8 each have 40 crossings, 41 bounded regions, and tangent index 11, but strangeness 15 and 11. Three close-ups show the first triple passage, before, near the meeting, and after. Each passage has a reflected partner below the axis.

g.text: The same counts, a different weave
Three branches pass through one another
The first meeting, magnified at equal scales. Its local strangeness jump is −1.
Two reflected pairs of passages have individual jumps −1, totaling −4.
Exact endpoint integers and complete event counts in two short weight windows; rounded figure geometry.
